mercuriale.config.title: Mercuriale
mercuriale.config.subtitle: Item prices on VikingCraft, when you put your mouse on an item.
mercuriale.config.hint: Scroll to go down · prices come from the VkAnalyzer website
mercuriale.config.enabled.tip: Shows how much an item is worth at the auction house and in player shops. Only works on VikingCraft.
mercuriale.config.market.tip: The price the item usually sells for at the auction house, and how many sales it's based on.
mercuriale.config.shops.tip: The cheapest shop to buy it, and the shop that buys it back for the most. Not for renamed items.
mercuriale.config.amount.tip: The price of one item, of the whole stack, or both.
mercuriale.config.enchant_value.tip: On an item with server enchants: how much the enchants, slot augmenters and rune are worth, then the total. Off, you can still see them by holding the key.
mercuriale.config.bargains.tip: At the auction house, each listing is green if it's cheaper than usual, red if it's more expensive.
Used to find the auction house menu. Don't change it if you're not sure.
Used to find the price in a listing. Don't change it if you're not sure.
mercuriale.config.container_value.tip: When you open a chest, barrel or shulker, shows how much everything inside is worth. Shulkers stored inside aren't counted.
mercuriale.config.server_menu_pattern.ti: Used so server menus (auction house, shops) don't count as chests. Don't change it if you're not sure.
mercuriale.config.radar_values.tip: In Chest Radar, under each item: how much you'd make by selling all you have.
mercuriale.config.shop_undercut.tip: To work out what your shop would make: the lowest price from others, minus this percentage.
mercuriale.config.server.tip: Prices only show on this server. Empty = on every server.
mercuriale.config.url.tip: Prices are updated every 5 minutes. Don't change it if you're not sure.
mercuriale.bargain.label: This listing
mercuriale.bargain.even_market: same price as the auction house
